second_audit.verdict_rationale: The representation-ring expansion has the correct beta/(2N) normalization, nonnegative multiplicities, and convolution eigenvalues a_lambda/d_lambda; its trace normalization is w_beta(1). Independent algebra also confirms gauge-projector commutation, the positive sandwich, half-weight and Wilson-scalar accounting, the selected-versus-repeated source grammar, the Schur-power derivative kernel, and the SU(3) coefficient 1/6. The runner is finite-carrier support rather than the analytic proof, but it genuinely computes the stated support checks and exposes no source-runner drift.
